Walt Disney Attractions Technology LLC, part of Disney Experiences, develops digital and technology experiences for Disney’s vacation brands. The Associate Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, and maintains software components and systems, including PHP and Java libraries and integrations for the POS platform.

Responsibilities
You will analyze, design, program, debug, and modify software enhancements and/or new products used in local, networked, cloud-based or Internet-related computer programs. Your code may either be used in commercial and end-user applications, or may focus on software and tools in support of infrastructure and technology platforms. The deliverables are typically large or highly complex software programs and systems, and you may interact with users to define system requirements and/or necessary modifications
Contribute to software enhancements and/or new products used in local, networked, cloud-based, or Internet-related computer programs on existing frameworks or libraries
Using existing procedures, you will help design, develop, test, and implement software components, fixes, enhancements, and/or new systems and applications
Maintain and upgrade of PHP and Java Component libraries
Engage with mobile development team to design API contracts and implement system integrations for our POS platform
Perform Open Source Software Technical Reviews to align with DX compliance goals
Enable external teams and guide them through new developer onboarding as well as integrations
You will gain knowledge of current programming language and technologies, code writing, programming, and testing and debugging of applications
Your code may either be used in commercial and end-user applications or may focus on software and tools in support of infrastructure and technology platforms
